property_summary: The lockInGuess function always requires exactly 1 ether in the original, but only 0.5 ether in the mutant, so the mutant allows a guess to be locked in with 0.5 ether, violating the invariant that a successful non-reverting lockInGuess call must have been accompanied by exactly 1 ether.
change_summary: Change require(msg.value == 1 ether) to require(msg.value == 0.5 ether) so different payment amount changes observable state.
